links.outcome: Gap between base accuracy and robust accuracy under counterfactual clinical perturbation
links.effect: Base accuracy overstates robust accuracy by 16-28 percentage points in every model; residual BTR of 20% with EA-RAG.
links.quote: Across eight configurations of four frontier LLMs, base accuracy overstates robust accuracy by 16-28 percentage points in every model.

links.outcome: Bias Trap Rate and base accuracy with retrieval-grounded method (EA-RAG) on Claude Sonnet 4.6
links.effect: EA-RAG achieved 20.3% BTR and 65.0% robust accuracy, a 5.5 percentage point BTR reduction without degrading base accuracy.
links.quote: EA-RAG achieves 20.3% BTR and 65.0% robust accuracy on Claude Sonnet 4.6, a 5.5 percentage point BTR reduction without degrading base accuracy.

unlisted_practices: Counterfactual paired-case benchmarking (Bias Trap Rate) to measure diagnostic robustness
Evidence-coverage retrieval with clinical parameter extraction, coverage auditing, and contrastive sub-queries

screen.practice: retrieval grounding (EA-RAG) added to existing LLMs
screen.reason: The paper introduces a benchmark (MamaBench) to test diagnostic robustness of LLMs using counterfactual pairs, and tests Evidence-Anchored RAG (a retrieval grounding safeguard) against standard base models to evaluate reduction in bias trap rate.
